notes:
The Leafs don't appear to have played last night, Sunday, Oct 11, 2026. They did play the night before, on Saturday, Oct 10, and won.

- Yahoo Sports' schedule lists the Leafs' October games on the 3rd, 6th, 8th and 10th, and the next one at Utah on the 13th. Nothing is listed for the 11th or 12th.
- Saturday, Oct 10, at Colorado: William Nylander scored twice and had three assists in the Toronto Maple Leafs' 6-3 win against the Colorado Avalanche at Ball Arena on Saturday. (NHL.com recap)
- NHL.com's recap is dated Oct 11, which may be why the game looks like "last night". Its video page also dates the highlights Oct 11.
- Auston Matthews scored twice and had two assists, Nick Blankenburg scored in his Toronto debut, and the Leafs (3-2-1) got their first road win of the season.
- Yahoo's headlines from Oct 11 mention an injury to Chris Tanev, who left that game early. Athlon Sports reported an injury update.
